svg.aria-label: Two months you cannot leave, and a six-week window
svg.text: Two months you cannot leave, and a six-week window
8-10 weeks. Interim receipt: no travel, no re-entry
Travel is generally possible on a valid passport and the existing card
The receipt says on its face that it is not a travel document. The renewal window opens three months out and closes six weeks out.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 5 September 2026
